# Facts: Kernel driver and WDDM

The kernel-mode driver under Windows: WDDM start, dxgkrnl and VidMm contracts, paging, GART and page tables, submission, fences, residency, TDR and bugchecks, packages and deployment. 337 facts (237 MEASURED, 99 CONFIRMED, 1 REFUTED).

Source: [`data/kmd.yaml`](data/kmd.yaml). Graphs: [`graphs/kmd.md`](graphs/kmd.md). All areas: [`../facts.md`](../facts.md). Live facts only: [`current.md`](current.md). Links in the text are relative to `docs/` in the data and rewritten for this page.
